_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Mì sɛ̀ ɖò Snake lɛ̀ {width}×{height} kà.
A xɔ̀ sɛ̀ ɖò {player_id} ɖò. Wàzu a xɔ̀ wɛ̀: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (alo w/s/a/d).
Nùkɔ̀n: ku dò gbɛ̀n ɖò lɛ̀n ɖò, alo ku dò gɛ̀n ɖò lɛ̀n ɖò bɔ̀ ɖìaɖìaɖì (aɖì {max_turns} ɖìaɖì).

game_action.invalid_death: Dǒ {player_id} kú ɖó nùɖé wà ǎ wutu.

outcome.survived_win: {player_id} ɔ́ ɖíɖá; mɛ ɖě lɛ́ɛ bǐ kú.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Dǒ lɛ bǐ kú ɖò hwe ɖokpo ɔ mɛ.
outcome.outlived: Kántóo ɔ nɔ gbɛ hú mɛ ɖevo lɛ bǐ.
outcome.turn_limit: E kpò ɖò fí e è ɖó na lɛ́ kɔ dó é - mɛ nɔ mɔ nǔ jɛ nukɔn hugǎn ɔ wɛ ɖu bɔ̀ è ɖè yeɖée.
